# Colver Systems — Comprehensive Context & Platform Knowledge

## Overview
Colver Systems (Colver) is a modern technology and software engineering consultancy that delivers high-performance digital platforms, bespoke software, modern web applications, and enterprise automations.

Website: https://colver.in
Primary Contact: info@colver.in

## Detailed Services Breakdown

### 1. Custom Web Applications
- Sub-second initial page loads and zero layout thrashing (CLS <= 0.05).
- Server-side prerendering and edge hydration using Next.js App Router and TypeScript.
- Resilient client state management and fluid micro-interactions with GSAP and Framer Motion.

### 2. Digital Commerce & Payment Infrastructure
- Specialized integrations for Indian digital commerce: UPI (Unified Payments Interface), Razorpay, PayU, Stripe.
- Multi-currency transaction processing with automated tax calculation.
- Live multi-location inventory synchronization and checkout fraud detection.

### 3. Inventory & Operations Management
- Real-time multi-godown stock management, batch tracking, and expiry tracking.
- Automated OCR and PDF document extraction for invoices, delivery challans, and receipts.
- Role-based operational access control (RBAC) and audit trails.

### 4. AI & Workflow Automation
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and domain-specific knowledge pipelines.
- Intelligent triage agents for customer inquiries and internal support tickets.
- Automated API integrations across legacy ERPs, databases, and third-party SaaS tools.

## Architectural Security
- Zero-dependency vulnerability posture (audited with Cloudflare Security Audit methodology).
- Strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers blocking unauthorized third-party scripts and cross-site exfiltration.
- Enforced HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) with max-age=31536000 and preload.
- Edge origin protection and rate-limited API endpoints.
